```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axis
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))

# Create a boxplot to show the distribution of transaction amounts by transaction type and fraud status
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='is_fraud', palette='Set2')

# Add labels and title
plt.title('Transaction Amounts by Type and Fraud Status')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Transaction Amount')

# Add a legend
plt.legend(title='Is Fraud', loc='upper right')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
